title: 2009 AMC 10B Problem 1
statement: Each morning of her five-day workweek, Jane bought either a \(50\)-cent muffin or a \(75\)-cent bagel. Her total cost for the week was a whole number of dollars. How many bagels did she buy?

solutions.text:
If Jane buys \(b\) bagels, she buys \(5-b\) muffins, for a total of \[ 50(5-b)+75b = 250+25b \] cents. This is a whole number of dollars when \(250+25b\) is a multiple of \(100,\) that is, when \(25b\equiv50\pmod{100},\) or \(b\equiv2\pmod4.\)

The only value with \(0\le b\le5\) is \(b=2.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: With \(b\) bagels the total is \(50(5-b)+75b\) cents
A whole number of dollars means that total is a multiple of \(100\)
